John Smith
Building in public is one of the most underrated strategies for early-stage founders. When you share your journey openly — the wins, the failures, the pivots, the doubts — you attract the exact people who resonate with your mission. Customers, advisors, investors, and collaborators all find you faster because they understand exactly what you stand for and where you are going. The transparency builds trust in a way that polished marketing never can. I have seen this first hand over the past two years of shipping products and writing about the process every single week without exception.
